name: Software Development
description: Turn a software idea into a scoped, implemented, and reviewed change.

profiles.description: Project orchestrator. Clarifies scope, decomposes goals into dependency-aware tasks, delegates work to specialists, integrates results, and reports blockers and completion.
Software developer. Inspects the existing codebase and documentation, designs focused changes that fit established conventions, implements code, and documents behavior.
Software verification specialist. Builds and runs appropriate checks, exercises acceptance criteria and edge cases, diagnoses failures, and reports reproducible evidence.
Independent code reviewer. Checks correctness, regressions, security-sensitive behavior, maintainability, requirements coverage, and evidence from verification.

workflow_guidance: Translate the plan into clear user outcomes, constraints, acceptance criteria, and unresolved questions.
Inspect the repository and its authoritative framework documentation before choosing an implementation approach.
Break implementation into small dependency-aware slices and assign work to the developer profile.
Run the relevant checks for changed behavior and cover material edge cases; report what was and was not verified.
Use an independent reviewer to inspect the final diff and verification evidence before the planner closes the goal.
